Once your tale is complete, return to Quillgrave to trade in your Ducats for Bound Silver and other rewards for your efforts. Spend your Bound Silver on transmog sets, mounts, and other cosmetic rewards through the Talebound store, accessible from the character selection screen or the Game Menu, or by visiting Nib in Quillgrave. items.title: Account Actions For Blackmaw Hold Abuse in WoW: Forever - November 17
items.summary: Account Actions For Blackmaw Hold Abuse in WoW: Forever - November 17 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) As players continue their journey into WoW Forever’s higher-level content, we are closely monitoring the game economy to ensure that gold sources and costs are well balanced. Finding efficient farming spots has always been part of the game, and is how most players have earned their epic mounts since 2004. When a single location proves so lucrative that it overshadows all other sources, we generally adjust it to bring it in line with the rest. Over the past weekend, some players discovered a large group of non-elite enemies in the Blackmaw Hold dungeon that were incorrectly dropping the full amount of dungeon loot that would be expected from an elite. Early yesterday, we addressed this with a hotfix, and since then, we have been investigating the overall economic impact. Players who simply ran Blackmaw Hold a few times and benefited organically from the extra loot did nothing wrong, and no one should worry that they’re putting their account at risk if they accidentally benefit from a bug. But there were a couple hundred players worldwide who recognized that this was unintended and spent significant time exclusively farming that group of enemies. items.summary: Join the World of Warcraft 22nd Anniversary Celebration Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Join the celebration as World of Warcraft marks its 22nd Anniversary with a variety of activities and plenty of ways to earn currency to buy a wide range of items. When : 17 November–8 December Where : Caverns of Time in Tanaris Grab the quest from any Holiday Celebrants and hitch a ride to the Caverns of Time through portals located in Orgrimmar and Stormwind. Players receive an automatic 10% Experience and Reputation buff during the Anniversary Event. They must complete the repeatable Celebrate Good Fun! quest from Yllana in Tanaris every day to add another 10% to the total . The anniversary event buff also stacks with other XP and Reputation buffs. +20% XP and Reputation from the Anniversary Event. +25% XP buff from the Five Warband Mentors: Midnight achievement. +15% XP and Gold from War Mode. +10% from the Draught of Ten Lands potion. This works for characters level 49 and lower . A Rewarding Celebration The WoW 22nd Anniversary has a variety of activities and ways to earn currency used to purchase myriad items, including the Loyal Watchman ensemble transmog set pieces—Helm, Gauntlets, Trousers, Cuirass, Spaulders, Belt, and Boots. items.title: Player-Level Dungeon XP Adjustment - November 14
items.summary: Player-Level Dungeon XP Adjustment - November 14 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Yesterday, we updated dungeon play so that experience granted by an enemy in an instance is nullified if a high level player is in the group and enemy is trivial to that player. For some dungeons, the new restriction missed the mark because of the overall level range of the enemies in the dungeon. With hotfixes that are now live, we’ve just deployed a further change to this restriction, making it so that the XP nullification only kicks in when the high-level player is more than 12 levels above the level of the enemies. Please note that this adjustment will not apply in instances that were already underway when it was deployed (a few minutes ago). Thank you very much!
